datasets.product: Unified Geologic Map of the Moon
datasets.citation: Fortezzo, C.M., Spudis, P.D., and Harrel, S.L. (2020), Unified Geologic Map of the Moon, USGS, scale 1:5,000,000.
limitations: Map-scale geological context, not detailed lithological or quantitative mineral composition.
Source vertex spacing ~3 km and smoothing tolerance ~16 km; AOI overlap does not improve map accuracy.
Moon 2000 sphere, planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude, LOLA control; no WGS84.

datasets.license: USGS-authored GIS in public domain; copyrighted third-party materials, if identified, excluded.
datasets.citation: Sun, V.Z., and Stack, K.M. (2020), Geologic map of Jezero crater and the Nili Planum region, Mars, USGS SIM 3464, doi:10.3133/sim3464.
limitations: 1:75,000 geological interpretation from imagery, not a mineral abundance raster.
Coverage restricted to 76.8..77.8 E, 17.7..18.7 N.
Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric latitude and east-positive longitude; no WGS84.

datasets.provider: Du, Kecheng; Liu, Sicong / Tongji University
datasets.citation: Du et al. (2026), Quantitative Mineral Maps of the Lunar South Polar Region Derived From the Moon Mineralogy Mapper (M3) Data, doi:10.1029/2024JE008842; dataset doi:10.5281/zenodo.20725024.
limitations: Research-derived estimates, not direct laboratory composition.
MAT lacks embedded CRS, affine transform, units, QA, valid range and uncertainty. No AOI extraction enabled.
Legacy 15549419 TIFFs are RGB visualizations and cannot be interpreted as mineral abundance.
Paper abstract covers 83..90 S; registration of the v4 matrix is not established.

datasets.provider: NASA PDS Geosciences Node / MRO CRISM
datasets.version: MTR3; selected product version recorded in provenance
datasets.license: Data sets archived in the PDS are in the public domain.
datasets.citation: MRO CRISM MTRDR, NASA PDS; product IDs and source labels pinned in manifest artifacts.
limitations: Spectral parameters are context only; no validated mineral identification or abundance conversion.
Coverage is finite non-fill pixels, not validated mineral detections; atmospheric/instrument residuals may remain.
Bounded ODE metadata query, first five products; one smallest summary cube selected, not exhaustive survey.
MTRDR uses a latitude-dependent custom Mars sphere; retain original CRS and native pixel size.

datasets.license: NASA Earth science data and information policy
datasets.citation: Green, R., EMIT L2B Estimated Mineral Identification and Band Depth and Uncertainty 60 m V002, NASA LP DAAC, doi:10.5067/EMIT/EMITL2BMIN.002
limitations: V002 is current formal release as verified by CMR on 2026-11-14; historical reprocessing is ongoing.
V001 is audited separately for historical coverage; never silently substituted for V002.
Native swath, not orthorectified; require geolocation, quality mask and uncertainty before observation use.
Band depths and mineral IDs are not mineral weight percentages.
CMR bbox hit is potential footprint coverage, never validated observation coverage.
